verdict.wrong_value: TypeError raised instead of returning False/True for comparison operations with NaN Quantity
verdict.rationale: This PR fixes handling of NaN (a special floating-point value) in comparison operations between TimeDelta objects and Quantity objects containing NaN. The bug manifests as a TypeError being raised when comparing TimeDelta with np.nan * u.s, instead of following standard NaN comparison semantics (all ordering comparisons and == return False, != returns True, no exception). This is a mishandled special value (NaN) that violates the expected numerical comparison behavior. The fix ensures TimeDelta comparisons with NaN Quantities behave consistently with IEEE 754 NaN semantics, which is a core numerical correctness issue.
